title: Odderon in the diffractive dip region
summary: We examine possible $C$-odd effects in elastic proton-proton and proton-antiproton scattering in the diffractive dip region. Collider data with $\sqrt{s}>500$ GeV are fitted for $0.2<|t|<1~\GeV^2$, using a simple Regge-inspired parametrization of effective $C$-even and $C$-odd amplitudes. The relative phases are not left free, but are fixed by the signature factors of the corresponding even and odd contributions.
